definitions.explanation: Any living entity, including animals, plants, and microorganisms.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}には{様々|さまざま}な{生物|せいぶつ}がいる。
examples.english: There are various organisms in the ocean.

examples.japanese: {生物|せいぶつ}{多様性|たようせい}を{守|まも}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{微|び}{生物|せいぶつ}は{目|め}に{見|み}えない。
examples.english: Microorganisms cannot be seen with the naked eye.

notes:
{生物|せいぶつ} is the scientific term for living things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生物|せいぶつ}{学|がく} (biology)
- {微|び}{生物|せいぶつ} (microorganism)
- {生物|せいぶつ}{多様性|たようせい} (biodiversity)
- {海洋|かいよう}{生物|せいぶつ} (marine life)
- {生物|せいぶつ}{兵器|へいき} (biological weapon)

COMPARISON:
- {生物|せいぶつ}: living thing (scientific)
- {生|い}き{物|もの}: living thing (everyday, often animals)
- {動物|どうぶつ}: animal
